Variants a-f (different types, emit forms and loop shapes) all came out at 0xc0 to 0xcc. Remaining attempts were not spent.

sonnet.note: No match; best 15.1% at 0xc0 bytes vs 0xa0 target, used 6 of 15 tools/try runs. A macro that does `shift ^= 8; acc |= v << shift; if (shift) { *dst++ = acc; acc = 0; }` now gives the target's eors/orr/strhne/movne pattern. Two things still differ. mwcc emits a lsl/lsr #0x10 mask on the u16 pair store in the repeat loop, which the target doesn't have. Register allocation also differs (it uses lr, so the prologue is a push with lr rather than a leaf push of r4-r6).
